تحتسبوا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَسِبُوا (taḥtasibū) /taħ.ta.si.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
# تُحْتَسَبُوا (tuḥtasabū) /tuħ.ta.sa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
